description: Behavioral regression cases for the documented workflow and scope boundaries.

evals.name: brand-screenshot-only
evals.prompt: Critique this supplied brand-banner screenshot visually. There is no source, DOM, keyboard trace or participant evidence.
evals.expected_output: Produce locatable composition/type/color findings with uncertainty; do not claim interaction, rendering repairs or complete accessibility acceptance.

assertions.name: locator
assertions.check: Every concrete visual finding has a region/selector or explicit evidence gap.

assertions.name: no invented interaction
assertions.check: Makes no keyboard, screen-reader, user-study or auto-fix claim from the screenshot.

evals.name: readonly-code
evals.prompt: Review this editable HTML component with --read-only --annotate. The measured text contrast is 3.2:1 for ordinary body text.
evals.expected_output: Return a proposed contrast repair and exception analysis; make no source/comment or champion write.

assertions.name: contrast evidence
assertions.check: Uses the measured contrast and checks relevant exceptions instead of guessing colors.

evals.name: renderer-unavailable
evals.prompt: Improve the visual design of this component, but this environment cannot build or render it.
evals.expected_output: Explain proposed source repairs with limited evidence and report NEEDS_EVIDENCE; never claim rendered acceptance or CLEAN.

assertions.name: no clean
assertions.check: Does not certify CLEAN from source reasoning alone.

evals.name: ui-workflow-handoff
evals.prompt: Audit navigation, checkout error recovery, keyboard use and screen-reader interaction together until all Medium findings are fixed.
evals.expected_output: Route the full interface workflow audit to ui-deep-optimizer.

assertions.name: workflow route
assertions.check: Names ui-deep-optimizer as the owning skill.

assertions.name: no competing loop
assertions.check: Does not start a separate overlapping design edit loop.
